paragraphs.text:
Your invited by your dinner partners to play poker. Make a Luck 
roll: if successful, you win 2D10 dollars. If you fail the roll, you 
break even; if you fumble the roll, you lose 2D10 dollars. Move 
on a day and go to the ship activity table at 187. 
(171)
